hot-pink.$description: Oxblood. Resonant substitute for Epidemic Sound hot pink. Full-bleed chapter backgrounds only, never a small tint or button fill.

sun-yellow.$description: Sun Yellow. Decorative only. Not used as a section or CTA.

signal-blue.$description: Void card standing in for Epidemic Sound signal blue. Secondary dark chapter, not a candy accent.

leaf-green.$description: Leaf Green. Decorative only. Not a CTA.

ink-black.$description: Ivory type on the void glaze. Filled CTA is this ivory stamp on the dark canvas.

charcoal.$description: Raised void card. Player and secondary dark surface.

slate.$description: Warm muted type for helper text and labels.

bone.$description: Lifted dark card for rows, ghost buttons, and nav tint.

paper-white.$description: Void canvas. The former paper-white post, glazed like the gold reference: near-black with a warm bronze undertone.

mist.$description: Slightly lifted void for cards and disabled states.

sand.$description: Gold glaze highlight. Chart-line bronze from the reference, not a CTA fill.

inter.$description: Workhorse sans for body, nav, buttons, and functional UI.

sebentafont-custom-editorial-serif.$description: Public substitute for sebentaFont. Display and large headings only. Italic is the emphasis system.

hot-pink-block.$description: Oxblood full-bleed chapter. Substitutes Epidemic Sound hot pink.

signal-blue-block.$description: Void full-bleed chapter. Substitutes Epidemic Sound signal blue.
